53:         use std::os::unix::io::{AsRawFd, FromRawFd};
54: 
55:         // NB: We give each driver a "fresh" receiver file descriptor to avoid
56:         // the issues described in alexcrichton/tokio-process#42.
57:         //
58:         // In the past we would reuse the actual receiver file descriptor and
59:         // swallow any errors around double registration of the same descriptor.
60:         // I'm not sure if the second (failed) registration simply doesn't end
61:         // up receiving wake up notifications, or there could be some race
62:         // condition when consuming readiness events, but having distinct
63:         // descriptors for distinct PollEvented instances appears to mitigate
64:         // this.
65:         //
66:         // Unfortunately we cannot just use a single global PollEvented instance

68:         // point to the exact same reactor.
